about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-17 from commit ad6b13a), since its mage sim ships no weights. Its Fire preset (talents, rotation, buffs) on its own Preraid gear set (ui/specs/mage/dps/gear_sets/preraid.gear.json, which every mage build uses), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. The tool's new per-school spell hit rows were left out. Run in the app's browser on 17 Nov 2026 (US Central). Before it (15 Nov, from e4ef929): Intellect 0.3, Spell Damage 1.0, Arcane Spell Damage 0.12, Fire Spell Damage 0.88, Frost Spell Damage 0.0, Spell Piercing 1.96, Spirit 0.0, 1% Hit 15.86, 1% Crit 10.43, 1% Haste 10.48, Mana 0.0, MP5 0.0.
